subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Periodicals—Japan
subfiles.about: An administrative inventory summarizes and cross-references diplomatic records concerning Japanese periodicals, publications, and related wartime press matters.
subfiles.summary: Docket (1940-42) covers suppressed magazine Gaiko Jiho, Japan News Week and Nippon issues, a Russo-Japanese War study request, and Moscow reports on curtailed Japanese magazines.

interest: Shows Japan's wartime press censorship and propaganda, and the overseas circulation of Japanese publications.
